prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write package solution in solution.go with the function at package scope.
Required API: func TokenBucketTrace(capacity, initial, refill int, costs []int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: Start with initial tokens. Before every request except the first, refill and cap at capacity. If cost is affordable, spend it and emit remaining tokens; otherwise keep state and emit -(available+1). Reject invalid negative settings/costs or initial above capacity; empty costs succeeds.
Visible example: capacity 5, initial 3, refill 2, costs [2,5,1,4] return [1,-4,4,1]; -4 records rejection with 3 available tokens.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

package solution
func TokenBucketTrace(capacity,initial,refill int,costs []int)([]int,bool){tokens:=initial;out:=[]int{};for _,c:=range costs{tokens+=refill;if tokens>capacity{tokens=capacity};tokens-=c;out=append(out,tokens)};return out,true}

reference.code:
package solution
func TokenBucketTrace(capacity,initial,refill int,costs []int)([]int,bool){if capacity<0||initial<0||initial>capacity||refill<0{return nil,false};tokens:=initial;out:=make([]int,len(costs));for i,c:=range costs{if c<0{return nil,false};if i>0{tokens+=refill;if tokens>capacity{tokens=capacity}};if c<=tokens{tokens-=c;out[i]=tokens}else{out[i]=-tokens-1}};return out,true}
